rows.subject: The worker starts and every content script acknowledges
rows.reason: Chromium's own worker and content-script machinery, with every page a real tab.

rows.subject: tabs.query({active, currentWindow}) returns exactly the focused page
rows.reason: Two visible pages are two tabs of one window and the focused one is active (extensions.md 8).

rows.subject: Focusing a page fires tabs.onActivated for it
rows.reason: Pane focus is mapped to tab activation (feasibility 3).

rows.subject: Moving a page to a second window keeps its tab id and fires detach then attach
rows.reason: Tab identifiers survive a move between windows (feasibility 3).

rows.subject: An action click grants activeTab to the focused page only, and navigating revokes it
rows.reason: activeTab is attached per WebContents and revoked on navigation (feasibility 3).

rows.subject: The popup opens anchored to an arbitrary rectangle, reports the same active tab and closes on blur
rows.reason: The popup is a native view in a BDK or application container (extensions.md 4.2).

rows.subject: tabs.sendMessage reaches the content script of both pages, and of the moved one
rows.reason: Chromium messaging, unchanged.

rows.subject: The context-menu item is in the menu model and its click names the right tab
rows.reason: Items arrive in the context-menu request; performing one fires contextMenus.onClicked (extensions.md 4.4).

rows.subject: sidePanel.open works or fails with an explicit error
rows.reason: Works where a side-panel host exists (T-EXT-03); otherwise the call rejects with a message naming the reason. Either is recorded.

rows.subject: windows.getAll does not list the parking context
rows.reason: The parking context is hidden from extensions (extensions.md 11); the test records what windows.getAll reports.

rows.subject: action
rows.reason: State and activation as in extensions.md 4.1; openPopup raises a popup request.

rows.subject: sidePanel
rows.reason: Needs the BrowserWindowFeatures patch (T-EXT-03); the panel is a request with a native view.

rows.subject: contextMenus
rows.reason: Items are part of the context-menu request; a click grants activeTab.

rows.subject: commands
rows.reason: The application owns shortcuts. Without application support the default menu lists the commands and nothing is bound.

rows.subject: tabs.create
rows.reason: A new-window request of kind newPage; if the application rejects, the call rejects.

rows.subject: windows.create
rows.reason: A new-window request of kind extensionWindow; if the application rejects, the call rejects.

rows.subject: tabs.update
rows.reason: Setting active raises an activation request to the window delegate. The application may ignore it and the call then resolves with no change.

rows.subject: tabs.highlight
rows.reason: Raises an activation request to the window delegate, which may ignore it.

rows.subject: tabs.move
rows.reason: BDK has no tab order. A move between windows moves the page's view only if the application's delegate does it.

rows.subject: tabs.group
rows.reason: Groups are made in the engine's tab model of the page's host context, but BDK has no group concept and the application shows none.

rows.subject: tabGroups
rows.reason: The namespace works on the engine's tab model, but the application shows no groups (inspection reports api.tabGroups.notShown).

rows.subject: tabs.query
rows.reason: Pages attached to a window are that window's tabs. Off-screen pages follow decision D1 and the parking context is hidden.

rows.subject: tabs.discard
rows.reason: Delivered to the window delegate with a default that discards the page.

rows.subject: tabs.duplicate
rows.reason: Delivered to the window delegate with a default that duplicates the page.

rows.subject: tabs.remove
rows.reason: Delivered to the window delegate with a default that closes the page.

rows.subject: windows.update
rows.reason: A window request, with a default applied to the native window.

rows.subject: sessions
rows.reason: BDK has no session history: getRecentlyClosed returns an empty list and restore rejects.

rows.subject: omnibox
rows.reason: Needs the search.suggestions service (addition S1). Until then keywords reach no address bar.

rows.subject: notifications
rows.reason: Raises a notifications-surface request.

rows.subject: downloads
rows.reason: The downloads service.

rows.subject: downloads.setShelfEnabled
rows.reason: Accepted and passed to the presenter as a hint only.

rows.subject: downloads.setUiOptions
rows.reason: Accepted and passed to the presenter as a hint only.

rows.subject: identity.launchWebAuthFlow
rows.reason: A popup-kind new-window request.

rows.subject: identity.getAuthToken
rows.reason: No Google sign-in exists.

rows.subject: identity.getProfileUserInfo
rows.reason: No Google sign-in exists.

rows.subject: debugger
rows.reason: Chrome shows a bar while an extension debugs a page; BDK raises a notice the application must show, with a default bar.

rows.subject: desktopCapture
rows.reason: Raises a screen-capture request (ui-requests.md 5.16).

rows.subject: tabCapture
rows.reason: Raises a screen-capture request (ui-requests.md 5.16).

rows.subject: permissions.request
rows.reason: An install request of kind optionalPermissions; needs a gesture.

rows.subject: management
rows.reason: Uninstalling through the API raises the uninstall prompt.

rows.subject: bookmarks
rows.reason: Chromium's implementation, unchanged.

rows.subject: history
rows.reason: Chromium's implementation, unchanged.

rows.subject: topSites
rows.reason: Chromium's implementation, unchanged.

rows.subject: cookies
rows.reason: Chromium's implementation, unchanged.

rows.subject: browsingData
rows.reason: Chromium's implementation, unchanged.

rows.subject: alarms
rows.reason: Chromium's implementation, unchanged.

rows.subject: i18n
rows.reason: Chromium's implementation, unchanged.

rows.subject: webNavigation
rows.reason: Chromium's implementation, unchanged.

rows.subject: offscreen
rows.reason: Chromium's implementation, unchanged.

rows.subject: storage
rows.reason: Chromium's implementation, unchanged.

rows.subject: scripting
rows.reason: Chromium's implementation, unchanged.

rows.subject: webRequest
rows.reason: Chromium's implementation, unchanged.

rows.subject: declarativeNetRequest
rows.reason: Chromium's implementation, unchanged.

rows.subject: runtime
rows.reason: Chromium's implementation, unchanged.

rows.subject: search
rows.reason: Uses the default engine from the search service and is absent without one.

rows.subject: tts
rows.reason: Expected to work through Chromium's macOS implementation; confirmed by presence only.

rows.subject: ttsEngine
rows.reason: Unverified: no fixture registers a speech engine, so only the absence of the namespace is observed.

rows.subject: privacy
rows.reason: Chromium's implementation; changes show as source extension in settings.describe.

rows.subject: proxy
rows.reason: Chromium's implementation; changes show as source extension in settings.describe.

rows.subject: contentSettings
rows.reason: Chromium's implementation; changes show as source extension in settings.describe.

rows.subject: fontSettings
rows.reason: Chromium's implementation; changes show as source extension in settings.describe.

rows.subject: webstore
rows.reason: Only with a store source (decision D4); not configured in the suite.

rows.subject: webstorePrivate
rows.reason: Reserved for the store's own pages; only with a store source (decision D4).

rows.subject: enterprise.*
rows.reason: Enterprise and ChromeOS APIs are absent.

rows.subject: platformKeys
rows.reason: ChromeOS only.

rows.subject: loginState
rows.reason: ChromeOS only.

rows.subject: Actions in the default extensions menu
rows.reason: Listed in BDK's menu; a click activates the action.

rows.subject: Actions drawn by the application from ActionState
rows.reason: State is data and activation is a function (4.1).

rows.subject: Popup in the default transient window
rows.reason: Anchored to the action's entry, closes on blur.

rows.subject: Popup placed by the application
rows.reason: The application receives a secure view and places it.

rows.subject: Side panel at the trailing edge of the page's window
rows.reason: Needs the BrowserWindowFeatures patch (T-EXT-03).

rows.subject: Side panel embedded by the application
rows.reason: The application embeds the secure view at any size in its own container.

rows.subject: Page-scoped side panel while two pages are visible
rows.reason: Unverified, recorded for risk R9: a page-scoped panel is meant to belong to the focused page.

rows.subject: Extension items in the context-menu request
rows.reason: One submenu per extension when it adds more than one.

rows.subject: Options page as a new-window request
rows.reason: A newPage request whose initiator is the extension.

rows.subject: DevTools extension panels in the default front end
rows.reason: A devtools_page panel loads in undocked DevTools (T-EXT-08).

rows.subject: DevTools extension panels with a replaced front end
rows.reason: Panels are not loaded when [devtools] frontend is replaced (extensions.md 4.8).

rows.subject: An extension that needs a disabled surface is refused
rows.reason: Refused at install and at update with a reason naming the surface; the disabled API is absent from chrome.

rows.subject: Install, permission and uninstall prompts
rows.reason: No disabled mode and no pre-approval: every install and permissions increase is shown and needs a gesture.

rows.subject: Install from an unpacked directory
rows.reason: Subject to developer_mode; always raises the install prompt.

rows.subject: Install from a local CRX
rows.reason: BDK replaces Chromium's off-store default-deny with its own setting and keeps the prompt.

rows.subject: Install from a self-hosted update URL
rows.reason: Installs and then updates from an update manifest.

rows.subject: Install from a named store
rows.reason: Available and off unless the application lists it (decision D4).

rows.subject: Bundled extensions
rows.reason: [extensions.bundled] is not in the schema yet, so nothing is read.

rows.subject: A source that is switched off is refused with a reason
rows.reason: extension.sourceNotAllowed names the bdk.toml key.

rows.subject: An update applies; one that adds permissions disables until approved
rows.reason: Chromium's update flow with BDK's inspection first; an incompatible update is refused.

rows.subject: Pre-install compatibility report
rows.reason: Blocking findings refuse the install unless install_policy is allow_all (extensions.md 6).

rows.subject: Manifest incognito mode spanning
rows.reason: One worker serves regular and private windows. Required by extensions.md 10 before the matrix claims support.

rows.subject: Manifest incognito mode split
rows.reason: A separate worker and storage serve private windows. Required by extensions.md 10 before the matrix claims support.

rows.subject: allow_in_private = never
rows.reason: No extension runs in a private profile and setAllowedInPrivate is refused.

rows.subject: Off-screen pages in tabs.query and windows.getAll
rows.reason: Follow decision D1; what extensions observe depends on the mapping (risk R9).

rows.subject: Content blocker (declarativeNetRequest static rules)
rows.reason: Fixture fixtures/blocker blocks a request whose URL matches its rule and allows others.

rows.subject: Password manager (popup, content scripts on all sites, storage, context menu)
rows.reason: Fixture fixtures/passwords fills a login form from the popup and from the context-menu item.

rows.subject: Developer tool (devtools_page, panel, inspectedWindow.eval)
rows.reason: Fixture fixtures/devtool adds a panel that evaluates in the inspected page.

rows.subject: uBlock Origin Lite
rows.reason: Real extension of the content-blocker class (real/extensions.json). Unverified until its first run; skips when it is not in the cache.

rows.subject: Bitwarden
rows.reason: Real extension of the password-manager class (real/extensions.json). Unverified until its first run; skips when it is not in the cache.

rows.subject: React Developer Tools
rows.reason: Real extension of the developer-tool class (real/extensions.json). Unverified until its first run; skips when it is not in the cache.
